claims.conclusion: Scope register complete; one asset out of scope with a judgment.
claims.statement: BTC and ETH meet all six ASC 350-60-15-1 criteria and are accounted for under ASC 350-60; WDEMO is excluded as a self-issued token.

claims.conclusion: Initial measurement per other GAAP; subsequent Level 1 fair value from the principal market.
claims.statement: In-scope crypto assets were initially measured at cost including transaction costs under ASC 350-30-30-1 and are subsequently measured at fair value under ASC 350-60-35-1 using principal-market quoted prices at 2026-06-30: BTC 650,000 USD and ETH 900,000 USD.

claims.conclusion: Roll-forward ties per asset and in total.
claims.statement: The Q2 2026 crypto asset roll-forward reconciles opening 1,850,000 USD to closing 1,550,000 USD through 250,000 USD of dispositions, 50,000 USD of gains and 100,000 USD of losses.
Crypto assets are presented separately from other intangible assets on the balance sheet, and remeasurement gains and losses are presented separately in net income.

claims.conclusion: Significant holdings table ties to total fair value and to the roll-forward.
claims.statement: Both holdings are significant and are disclosed with units, cost basis and fair value; no holding is subject to a contractual sale restriction; the cost basis method for realized gains and losses is FIFO.
